# FCICorrelation

Module: **FTI** · directory: `FTI/src/FCI` · binary: `FTI/src/Programs/FCI/FCICorrelation`

```text
FCICorrelation, version 0.01

Usage: FCICorrelation [options] 

Options:

system options:
    --state : name of the vector file describing the state whose density has to be plotted
    --density : plot density instead of density-density correlation
    --k-space : compute the density/correlation in momentum space
    --t1 : nearest neighbor hoping amplitude (default value = 1)
    --t2 : next nearest neighbor hoping amplitude (default value = 0.29289321881345243)
    --tpp : second next nearest neighbor hoping amplitude (default value = 0.20710678118654757)
    --mu-s : sublattice staggered chemical potential (default value = 0)

plot options:
    --output : output file name (default output name replace the .vec extension of the input file with .rho or .rhorho)
    --nbr-samplesx : number of samples along the x direction (value must be greater than 10, default value = 100)
    --nbr-samplesy : number of samples along the y direction (value must be greater than 10, default value = 100)

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

precalculation options:

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
